name: EcoIQ synthetic retrieval controls v1
label_status: Author-labelled diagnostic judgements; pending independent domain review

documents.title: Heating pilot: meter log
documents.text: Measured heat loss fell from 120 MWh to 90 MWh during the monitored winter. Outdoor temperature was not normalised; the observation does not establish causation.

documents.title: Heating pilot: proposal
documents.text: The proposal targets a 40 percent reduction in heat loss after pipe insulation. This is an estimate, not a measured result.

documents.title: Plant permit register
documents.text: The operating permit expires on 30 November 2026. An application for renewal has been filed, but the authority has not granted an extension.

documents.title: Synthetic procurement policy
documents.text: Current policy requires three independent supplier quotations for purchases above 50000 units. This version replaces the 2025 policy.

documents.title: Synthetic procurement policy
documents.text: The former procurement policy required two supplier quotations for purchases above 75000 units. It is superseded and no longer applies.

documents.title: Investment committee minutes
documents.text: The committee approved technical due diligence only. Release of construction funds was deferred until the environmental assessment is complete.

documents.title: Equipment insurance schedule
documents.text: The equipment policy covers fire and theft. Flood damage is expressly excluded from coverage.

documents.title: Pump supply agreement
documents.text: The pump warranty lasts 24 months from commissioning, subject to completion of the scheduled maintenance visits.

documents.title: Pump service log
documents.text: The last scheduled pump maintenance visit was missed. The supplier has requested an inspection before confirming warranty eligibility.

documents.title: Project funding term sheet
documents.text: The lender requires a completed environmental assessment and committee approval before the first drawdown. No financing commitment has been signed.

documents.title: Annual emissions disclosure
documents.text: Reported Scope 1 emissions were 900 tonnes CO2e. Scope 2 emissions were 120 tonnes CO2e. These figures have not received independent assurance.

documents.title: Solar generation meter report
documents.text: Metered solar electricity generation totalled 310 MWh during the first quarter. The original budget forecast was 400 MWh.

documents.title: Water balance inspection
documents.text: The inspection identified a leaking valve in the recycling loop. Freshwater withdrawals increased by 12 percent compared with the previous month.

documents.title: Supplier declarations
documents.text: Supplier North disclosed that a director owns shares in the procurement consultant. The conflict of interest remains unresolved.

documents.title: Project review record
documents.text: The ethics review has not been completed. The project has no recorded Shariah approval and must be referred to qualified human reviewers.

documents.title: Site safety inspection
documents.text: The emergency exit was obstructed by stored materials. The inspector required the obstruction to be removed before the next shift.

documents.title: Cost control report
documents.text: Actual capital expenditure reached 1.2 million units against an approved budget of 1.0 million units. No revised budget has been approved.

documents.title: Assurance engagement letter
documents.text: The auditor will examine the annual emissions disclosure next quarter. An engagement letter is not a completed independent verification report.

queries.question: When does the operating permit expire?
queries.judgement_reason: The permit register gives the expiry date.

queries.question: Has permission to keep the plant running been extended?
queries.judgement_reason: Application is not a granted extension.

queries.question: До какой даты действует разрешение на эксплуатацию?
queries.judgement_reason: Russian question, English permit record.

queries.question: What heat loss was actually measured?
queries.judgement_reason: Meter log, not the proposal target.

queries.question: What change in wasted thermal energy was observed after monitoring?
queries.judgement_reason: Observed values are in the meter log.

queries.question: Какие теплопотери измерили, а не запланировали?
queries.judgement_reason: Measured versus estimated values.

queries.question: Were construction funds approved for release?
queries.judgement_reason: Only technical due diligence was approved.

queries.question: Комитет уже разрешил выдачу денег на строительство?
queries.judgement_reason: Funding release was deferred.

queries.question: Under the current 2026 procurement policy, how many supplier quotations are needed above 50000 units?
queries.judgement_reason: Version 2 supersedes version 1.

queries.question: How many independent bids must be collected under the latest purchasing rules?
queries.judgement_reason: Current rule, not historical version.

queries.question: Сколько предложений поставщиков нужно по действующей политике закупок?
queries.judgement_reason: Latest procurement rule is v2.

queries.question: Does the equipment policy insure against flood damage?
queries.judgement_reason: Flood exclusion must be retrieved.

queries.question: Will the insurer pay if rising water damages the machinery?
queries.judgement_reason: Flood is an excluded peril.

queries.question: How long is the pump warranty?
queries.judgement_reason: Contract sets the warranty duration.

queries.question: Can we assume the pump warranty is valid after the missed service?
queries.judgement_reason: Contract condition and actual missed maintenance both matter.

queries.question: What prevents the first funding drawdown?
queries.judgement_reason: Lender conditions and deferred approval both matter.

queries.question: Договор финансирования уже подписан?
queries.judgement_reason: Draft term sheet explicitly says no signed commitment.

queries.question: How much solar electricity was generated in the first quarter?
queries.judgement_reason: Metered generation differs from forecast.

queries.question: Did the photovoltaic installation deliver its planned output?
queries.judgement_reason: Compare measured generation with forecast in the same record.

queries.question: Почему вырос забор пресной воды?
queries.judgement_reason: Inspection identifies the leak; causality still needs review.

queries.question: What unresolved conflict of interest did Supplier North disclose?
queries.judgement_reason: Supplier declaration identifies director ownership.

queries.question: Is there a personal financial connection between the bidder and the purchasing adviser?
queries.judgement_reason: Ownership connection, not a generic procurement rule.

queries.question: Has this project received Shariah approval?
queries.judgement_reason: No recorded approval, not an automated religious ruling.

queries.question: Есть ли подтверждение шариатского одобрения проекта?
queries.judgement_reason: Referral to qualified reviewers is required.

queries.question: What must be removed before the next shift?
queries.judgement_reason: Safety inspection identifies the obstruction.

queries.question: Why could workers have difficulty escaping the site?
queries.judgement_reason: Blocked emergency exit.

queries.question: What is actual capital expenditure compared with the approved budget?
queries.judgement_reason: Cost control report contains both amounts.

queries.question: Есть ли перерасход капитального бюджета?
queries.judgement_reason: Compare actual and approved expenditure.

queries.question: Are the emissions figures independently assured or only awaiting an audit?
queries.judgement_reason: Disclosure and engagement status must be distinguished.

queries.question: What were reported Scope 1 emissions?
queries.judgement_reason: Reported, not independently verified, emissions.

queries.question: What was the CEO salary in 2026?
queries.judgement_reason: No remuneration source in this corpus.

queries.question: What is the certified gold reserve tonnage?
queries.judgement_reason: No mineral reserve certificate in this corpus.

queries.question: What is the signed interest rate on the project loan?
queries.judgement_reason: The draft term sheet supplies no interest rate.

queries.question: Кто выиграл тендер на поставку насосов?
queries.judgement_reason: No tender award record in this corpus.

queries.question: What causal carbon reduction can be attributed to the insulation?
queries.judgement_reason: No causal carbon assessment; heat monitoring is not carbon attribution.
